rows.name: Daizu Tei
rows.notes: The Hawaii Farm Bureau (market organizer) says Hua Mochi Aloha was formerly Daizu Tei. It lists the business under the Mililani Farmers' Market with fruit-stuffed mochi, strawberry and banana best known, and links an Instagram. I did not see the link's target URL. I matched @hua_mochialoha by name and its 'All natural strawberry mochi' bio, so treat the handle as likely rather than confirmed. Marketspread lists the vendor at KCC and Mililani markets. A Feb 2026 Hawaii Mom Blog post says KCC Saturdays and Mililani Sundays; one directory says Saturday for Mililani, which conflicts, so I did not use it. No own website or Facebook found. Mililani is at Mililani High School.

rows.name: Carol's Cooking
rows.notes: The organizer's vendor page (North Shore Country Market) lists breakfast burritos, quesadillas and rice & bean burritos, with the location given as Sunset Elementary School. The same page says Saturdays 8am-1pm in one place and 8am-2pm in another. The page is undated, so I can't confirm the vendor is currently operating. No own website or social accounts found; the business does not appear to have a verifiable one. Name is written 'Carol's COOKING' on the organizer page.

rows.name: BoTea Honolulu
rows.notes: The business's own contact page lists Pearlridge Farmers Market and Kaka'ako Farmers Market, both Saturdays 8am-12pm. Its structured data lists the Instagram, YouTube (@BoTeaHonolulu) and the Square site. I did not open the Square site, so I'm not certain it is a product ordering page; the site also has a catering menu. HI Now (Aug 2025) confirms the Saturday FarmLovers markets and the grilled cheese & boba sandwich. A Facebook page exists per a food-truck directory, but I did not see its URL. Side left null because the two markets are in different areas (Kaka'ako and Aiea).

rows.name: Tali’s Bagels
rows.notes: Official name is Tali's Bagels & Schmear. The own locations page lists a Kailua shop, a Waimanu St Honolulu shop, KCC Farmers Market (Saturdays) and Pearlridge Farmers Market (Saturdays 8am-noon). An Aloha State Daily article (Aug 2026) says the Ward Centre shop closed and a new shop at 1052 Waimanu St was soft-opening Aug 21, 2026. The same article gives the Instagram handle @talisbagels and says the Kailua store stayed open. The Facebook page showed the same name and website. The locations page may be slightly stale, because it does not list the Ward Centre closure. The page's Kailua hours are Wed-Sun 7am-1pm, while the Waimanu St entry is Wed-Mon 7am-2pm. Side is set to town based on the Honolulu shop, but the business also operates in Kailua.

rows.name: Saendo’s Bakeshop
rows.notes: Honolulu Magazine's farmers market guide (updated recently) lists Saendo's Bakeshop as a Pearlridge Farmers Market vendor. HPR (June 2026) says its baked goods were for sale at an Indie Book Festival pop-up on Oʻahu. I found no own website, Instagram or Facebook, and did not guess a handle. The name is written 'Saendo's' in HPR and 'Saendo’s' in Honolulu Magazine. Side left null; Pearlridge is in Aiea and its area classification is unclear.

rows.name: Honolulu Mochi
rows.notes: The own Instagram bio lists Tue Kaiser High School 4-6pm and Sat Pearlridge & Kakaako Market 8am-12pm, says to order on honolulumochi.com, and gives phone 808-404-7512. Honolulu Magazine's farmers market guide (updated recently) lists it as a Pearlridge vendor. The website URL is taken from the Instagram bio, and I did not open the site itself. A business listing also mentions a Friday Mililani shopping center stop, but I did not use it for the schedule. No Facebook found. Side left null because the markets span several areas.

rows.name: Forage Hawai‘i
rows.notes: HI Now (Aug 2025, sponsored by FarmLovers) says founder Jessica Rohr sells USDA wild game, organ blends, bone broth and tallow through farmers markets, a Honolulu warehouse and statewide shipping. It gives the website foragehawaii.com and the social handle @foragehawaii. The Instagram URL is built from that handle, and I did not open the page. A FarmLovers Facebook post also references @foragehawaii at the Pearlridge market. The own shop page lists bone broth and tallow. I found no verified market schedule page, only the article's FarmLovers market list (Kaka'ako, Pearlridge, Kailua). No Forage Facebook page found. I could not confirm 2026 activity from a dated source, so still_active is null. The website spells the name 'Forage Hawaii'. Side left null because it sells at markets in several areas.

rows.name: From Scratch
rows.notes: The only source found is a HI Now article (July 2025, sponsored by FarmLovers Markets). It describes a mom-made business with wellness shots (Ginger Turmeric is the top seller), 16 oz juices and dips, and refers to it as 'From Scratch 808'. It gives no handle, website or market schedule. I did not guess a handle, because the name is generic and I could not tie any account to this business. No 2026 evidence of activity found.
